description: Southwest Climate Outlook is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Assessment for the Southwest; University of Arizona Cooperative Extension Service; Arizona State Climate Office. Each month, water managers, ranchers, farmers, and outdoor enthusiasts in Arizona and New Mexico can read summaries of recent climate and weather conditions and get outlooks for the coming month and season. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Severe Winter Weather, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
